purpose: svakīyabhāratibhavanārtham (for his own library, Bhāratī Bhavana)
notes: The manuscript quotes an earlier palm-leaf exemplar colophon mentioning the joint reign of the three brothers Jayadharmamalla, Jayajyotirmalla, and Jayakīrtimalla in Bhaktapur ('bhaktyāpurīnagaryā ca trayorājā virājate || dharmajyotiś ca kīrtiś ca jyeṣṭhamadhya kaniṣṭhayoḥ'). The cataloguer recorded Bhaktapur as place of copying based on this exemplar colophon. The present paper copy was prepared in VS [19]85 (1928 CE) by Pūrṇaprasāda Śarmā for Rājaguru Hemarāja Śarmā's collection (Bhāratī Bhavana).
